phase_prompt.label: Phase 2: The Silent Watch
phase_prompt.summary: The routine continues, but the weight of the task becomes apparent. The isolation of the command function is emphasized through lingering, static shots.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Hyper-realistic close-up. The reflective visor of the Leader fills the frame. In the reflection, we see the infinite repetition of the star gates. The figure is motionless, a statue of duty. The lighting is moody, with half the form obscured in shadow, emphasizing the 'Drama' genre's focus on inner burden. The texture of the obsidian skin is visible, flawless and cold. A single line of Geez code reflects on the glass surface.
